Chapter 356: Chapter 13: Spreading Martial Tao, Preemptive Planning (Happy New Year)_2

Chapter 356: Chapter 13: Spreading Martial Tao, Preemptive Planning (Happy New Year)_2

Furthermore,

even if the Tianqing Alliance Leader were to be lured over, there is a high likelihood that he would bring the World Sword with him.

The World Sword, a world weapon nurtured by the Tianqing World for countless years, could match the Ancestral Demon Tree in its heyday with a few moves beyond this world.

As for within this world… even Lin Yuan now would rather not confront the World Sword head-on.

And how to deal with the World Sword… Lin Yuan had long devised a plan.

Fundamentally speaking, the Tianqing Alliance Leader is not the true owner of the World Sword.

...

He is merely a temporary user; if it were not for the threat of the Foreign Evil God, the consciousness of the Tianqing World would never have allowed the World Sword to appear.

The very reason for the emergence of the World Sword is the Foreign Evil God.

As long as the Foreign Evil God is dealt with, the World Sword will no longer remain in the hands of the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

Therefore, Lin Yuan had no intention of immediately attacking the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

“I assign you two tasks,”

Lin Yuan looked down at the many powerful beings below and said slowly.

“Master, please command us,”

“Don’t worry, Master, even if it’s not just two tasks, but twenty or two hundred, we will accomplish them,”

“Right, Master, please tell us,”

…

Nearly three hundred strong beings listened intently with fervor.

As hosts to Demon Tree Seeds, they were naturally extremely obedient to Lin Yuan.

“Disseminate this cultivation system gradually,”

Using his mind, Lin Yuan slightly altered the Martial Arts Evolution System and, through the connection with the demon seeds, transmitted it to everyone’s minds.

This journey, apart from pioneering further stages in the Martial Arts Evolution System, spreading the Martial Arts Evolution System was also a plan Lin Yuan had long decided upon.

However, in his first hundred years after arriving in this realm, Lin Yuan’s identity was special and he dared not even show his face, let alone spread the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

But now it was different.

With the help of these local strong beings of the Tianqing World, spreading the Martial Path Evolutionary Path could not be easier.

“This cultivation system…”

“No problem, Master. Such a profound cultivation system will be wasted on those mere ants,”

“Rest assured, Master, we guarantee to accomplish the mission,”

Nearly three hundred strong beings vowed confidently.

“Hmm…”

Lin Yuan didn’t doubt them at all.

Because this task was indeed not difficult, especially since those present were high-ranking people from the Tianqing World.

What’s spreading a cultivation system?

Moreover, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has limitless potential; even without their advocacy, as long as it isn’t suppressed or targeted, it would spread slowly on its own.

“Another matter is to return to the Evil God Battlefield, get back to the side of the Tianqing Alliance Leader, pretend as if nothing has happened, and launch a counterattack against the Foreign Evil God,”

Lin Yuan spoke.

Destroying the Evil God Battlefield was one of Lin Yuan’s goals.

Without the Evil God Battlefield, the Ancestral Demon Tree would have to rely on him reaching the Fifth Stage and then establishing a spatial channel to descend upon the Tianqing World.

In doing so,

Lin Yuan would inevitably possess more bargaining chips to plan for more benefits.

Such as a substantial amount of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s Origin Power? Lin Yuan acquiring the Origin Power was not just to enhance his strength, but also to weaken the Ancestral Demon Tree.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.

Outside the Tianqing World,

Evil God Battlefield.

At this moment, the Evil God Battlefield was on the verge of collapse.

Under the forceful counterattack of the Tianqing World, it began to occupy a large area, while the Foreign Evil God, the Ancestral Demon Tree, dared not make a move under the guard of the Tianqing Alliance Leader wielding the World Sword.

“Damn it…”

In a distant illusion, the Ancestral Demon Tree’s presence turned chaotic, watching the Evil God Battlefield gradually turn to dust, its heart bleeding.

The Evil God Battlefield, refined from a special metal in the Outer Void, had cost the Ancestral Demon Tree untold efforts.

Through the Evil God Battlefield, the Ancestral Demon Tree could more easily penetrate the interior of the world.

But now, its efforts were collapsing.

Helpless, retrieving the Evil God Battlefield required a lot of time, and the Ancestral Demon Tree had to be present above the battlefield.

And this was something the Tianqing Alliance Leader would never allow.

“If my Origin Power hadn’t been depleted so much, would I be afraid of you…”

The Ancestral Demon Tree gritted its teeth. At its peak, even the Tianqing Alliance Leader alone could not have stopped it.

Therefore,

if the Tianqing Alliance Leader dared to launch a counterattack, the Ancestral Demon Tree would descend onto the battlefield, dragging the Tianqing Alliance Leader into a fierce battle nearby.

In this way, merely the repercussions of their battle would have been enough to sweep across the battlefield, making it impossible to take control of the battlefield.

But now,

with severe loss of Origin Power and the Tianqing Alliance Leader wielding the World Sword, he could drive him into a chase without sparing any attention for the overall situation on the battlefield.

…

Above the Evil God Battlefield,

the Tianqing Alliance Leader sat cross-legged, the World Sword floating before him, radiating layers of indescribable fluctuations that enveloped all around.

“It seems that the Evil God is not planning to make a move.”

the Tianqing Alliance Leader murmured to himself.

His purpose here was to wait for the Ancestral Demon Tree.

After all, launching a counterattack and destroying the Evil God Battlefield would, for the Ancestral Demon Tree, be akin to pulling chestnuts out of the fire.

Four hundred years ago, the Ancestral Demon Tree was able to easily forge the Evil God Battlefield because the Tianqing World was unprepared.

As long as the Evil God Battlefield is destroyed and the Tianqing World is prepared, even if the Ancestral Demon Tree gains a second Evil God Battlefield, it won’t be able to carve it out from beyond the world.

So,

in the eyes of the Tianqing Alliance Leader, launching the counterattack and destroying the Evil God Battlefield should cause the Foreign Evil God to struggle at least a little.

After all, the destruction of the Evil God Battlefield meant that the Foreign Evil God would no longer have an opportunity to descend into the Tianqing World.

“Duan Lang, with his masterful strategies and invincible strength, knows that the Foreign Evil God, even if it intervenes, cannot match him, so it has also refrained from making any meaningless moves…”

a stunningly beautiful woman appeared beside him and softly said to the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

“Ayan…”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader looked at the beautiful woman, a smile appearing on his face.

This woman, named Ayan, had an ambiguous relationship with him, and they had shared their hearts with each other frequently.

Only, because of the pressure from the Foreign Evil God, the Tianqing Alliance Leader had not yet confirmed their relationship with Ayan.

Of course, although their relationship was not confirmed, the Tianqing Alliance Leader had compensated Ayan in many ways, such as the position of Vice Alliance Hierarch and so on.

“Ayan, once we completely destroy the Evil God Battlefield, we can be together forever.”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader couldn’t help but embrace Ayan and whispered softly.

His heart had already started imagining all the wonderful things after they drove back the Foreign Evil God.

Then, he would take the woman he loved traveling and enjoying leisurely days.

And with the merit of repelling the Foreign Evil God, he would become the greatest cultivator in the history of Tianqing World, and be praised by countless future cultivators.

“Yes, then Ayan can be with Duan Lang… forever…”

the beautiful woman Ayan whispered, her tone tinged with a hint of shyness.

“Hahaha…”

“Of course.”

the Tianqing Alliance Leader laughed heartily.

However, what he did not notice was,

at this moment, nestled in his arms, Ayan’s eyes faintly flashed a strange light.

…

In the deepest part of the Black Mist Mountain Range,

Lin Yuan gazed toward the direction of the Evil God Battlefield.

“It looks like the war is nearly over.”

Separated by the world barriers, Lin Yuan was unable to perceive the specific situation on the Evil God Battlefield.

But through the life and death status of parasitic beings, he could infer that the counterattack must be going well.

Being a descendant of the Ancestral Demon Tree, Lin Yuan could just about sense the Ancestral Demon Tree’s general location.

Of course, the Ancestral Demon Tree could also sense Lin Yuan’s location.

According to Lin Yuan’s perception, the Ancestral Demon Tree had never approached the Evil God Battlefield.

Just then,

in the root area, the cluster of burning black flames suddenly began to fluctuate.

Lin Yuan saw this and immediately focused his mind before the black flames.

Shortly after,

a somewhat anxious and impatient voice from the Ancestral Demon Tree came from within the black flames.

“What stage have you reached now?”

“The situation here cannot be salvaged, it’s up to you now.”
